{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders (though QA orders are absent)
df_clean = df[~refunded_mask]

# Check the number of rows after filtering
print(f'Number of orders after removing refunded: {len(df_clean)}')

# Verify that no QA orders remain
qa_mask = df_clean['revenue'] == 999999.99
print(f'QA orders in cleaned data: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Check the distribution of channels and segments
df_clean[['channel', 'customer_segment']].value_counts()"}
